servicesIntro: From regular washes to full restoration, priced and planned around your boat.

services.name: Wash Programs
services.text: Weekly, bi-weekly and monthly washdowns to keep your boat clean.

services.name: 3-Step Full-Service Detail
services.text: A full wash plus mold, rust and metal work, then compound, polish and wax.

services.name: Oxidation Removal
services.text: Faded, chalky surfaces restored to a deep, glossy shine.

services.name: Gelcoat Restoration
services.text: Dull, faded gelcoat revived and protected from further damage.

services.name: Teak Treatment
services.text: Sanding, sealing and oiling to restore and renew your teak.

services.name: Bottom Paint
services.text: Paint refinishing and new paint, with Pettit and Hempel products.
